candidates.name: Band Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Row
Novice
1
Stand on your band with both feet.
2
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
3
Let your arms hang freely, then pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

candidates.name: Band Pullover
candidates.cardText:
Band Pullover
Novice
1
Place the band just above our level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
2
Push your hips back slightly. Extend and flex at the shoulder joint.

candidates.name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
candidates.cardText:
Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
Novice
1
Place the band at about eye level. Fall into a kneeling position.
2
The knee that is on the ground should be the same side as the working arm. Stick your chest out.
3
And then pull your elbow straight back. Flex your lats and then extend into the starting position.

candidates.name: Mini Band Overhead Fly
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Overhead Fly
Novice
1
Loop bands around wrists,, arms extended overhead.
2
Pull arms outward in arc motion.
3
Return slowly, controlling tension throughout movement.

candidates.name: Band Squat Hold Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Squat Hold Row
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a stable point.
2
Take a half squat position and hold there.
3
Perform a row while holding the squat position.

candidates.name: Band Single Arm Pulldown
candidates.cardText:
Band Single Arm Pulldown
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a high point. Go into a seated position.
2
Grab the loop of the band and pull your upper arm to your side.

candidates.name: Band Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Anchor band to a stable point.
2
Step back until there is no slack in the band and hold the end of the band with one hand.
3
Pull through the elbow straight back.

candidates.name: Band Single Arm Bent Over Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Single Arm Bent Over Row
Novice
1
Stand on band and hinge at hips, holding handle with arm extended.
2
Pull elbow toward your hip, keeping back flat and shoulders square.
3
Squeeze back at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Band Bent Over Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Bent Over Row
Beginner
1
Stand on band with feet hip-width, holding handles with palms facing in.
2
Hinge at hips, keeping back flat and elbows close to ribs.
3
Pull handles toward torso, squeeze back, then lower slowly with control.

candidates.name: Band Pull Around
candidates.cardText:
Band Pull Around
Novice
1
Stand sideways to anchor and hold band with arm slightly extended.
2
Pull arm across your body in a smooth arc without rotating torso.
3
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly with control.

candidates.name: Band Half Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
candidates.cardText:
Band Half Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
Novice
1
Kneel facing anchor with band overhead, holding the end of the band in one hand.
2
Keep torso tall and pull elbow down toward your hip.
3
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return arm slowly to starting position.

candidates.name: Band Seated Single Arm Pulldown
candidates.cardText:
Band Seated Single Arm Pulldown
Novice
1
Sit facing anchor with band overhead, holding handle in one hand.
2
Pull elbow down toward your hip while keeping chest tall.
3
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Band Seated Pulldown
candidates.cardText:
Band Seated Pulldown
Novice
1
Sit facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
2
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest lifted.
3
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Band Kneeling Pulldown
candidates.cardText:
Band Kneeling Pulldown
Novice
1
Kneel facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
2
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest tall.
3
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Mini Band Bent Over Row
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Bent Over Row
Novice
1
Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
2
Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
3
Lower under control, maintaining core tension.

candidates.name: Mini Band Kneeling Row
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Kneeling Row
Novice
1
Anchor band around foot, kneel tall holding ends.
2
Row elbow back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
3
Return slowly, maintaining upright torso.
